user.title: Connect to the bridge
user.description: Address of the TCP-to-RS485 bridge (for example an Elfin EW11) in transparent mode. Home Assistant only listens; it never sends anything on the bus.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open a TCP connection to this host and port. Check the address, and that no other client is connected to the bridge.

init.title: Registers
init.description:
Raw sensors: one disabled-by-default sensor per register seen on the bus. Enable the ones you want to watch.

Register map (YAML): named, scaled sensors. Example:
```
- name: Grid voltage
  address: 37
  scale: 0.1
  unit_of_measurement: V
  device_class: voltage
  state_class: measurement
```

data.raw_sensors: Create raw sensors for every register
